_doc: What the shaders share with the C++ core or the scripts, written once, by domain (tools/build/shader_contracts.py makes native/src/core/shader_contracts/<group>.h and project/render/shaders/contracts/<group>.gdshaderinc from each group, and core/shader_contracts/all.h of them all; the scripts read every value as CityStore.constants.shader; quick's shader_contracts task fails when any is older than this table). Each entry: name (unique across the groups), type (int, float, vec3, ints or floats a named set, enum with its values), value(s) (a number, or an expression both C++ and the shading language read the same) and doc (what it means, who writes it and who reads it). A side that needs a value derived from one (a threshold, a half, a mask, a product) derives it in its own code from this name, never types it.

agents.doc: the vehicles: their instance flags, palette, vertex tags and moving parts (render/agents; agents.gdshader, agent_door.gdshaderinc, agent_glass.gdshader)

entries.name: AGENT_DOOR_STEP
entries.doc: each step a vehicle's kerb door stands open, added over the brake's flag and the wheel's angle in the instance (agent_renderer.cpp writes, agent_door.gdshaderinc reads)

entries.name: AGENT_DOOR_LEVELS
entries.doc: the steps a kerb door opens by (pose_buffer.h LOOK_DOOR_MASK)

entries.name: AGENT_BRAKE_FLAG
entries.doc: added to the wheel's roll angle (0..TAU) when the brake light is on (agent_renderer.cpp, agents.gdshader)

entries.name: AGENT_PAINTS
entries.doc: the body paints of the agents' palette (agent_looks.cpp), first in agents.gdshader's paints

entries.name: AGENT_LINE_PAINTS
entries.doc: the transport lines' colours after them (agent_looks.cpp)

entries.name: AgentTag
entries.doc: what a vehicle vertex is, in its UV2.x (agent_meshes.h agent_tag; agents.gdshader)

entries.name: Limb
entries.doc: what the vertex stage moves, in UV2.y: UV its axle or its hinge; a door hung at its front edge, at its back edge (agent_meshes.h; agents.gdshader, agent_door.gdshaderinc read each as over the one below it by a half)

entries.name: AGENT_SILL_SPAN_M
entries.doc: a door pane's vertex colour red: its sill's height over this (car_body.cpp, agent_door.gdshaderinc)

people.doc: the people: their clip and body tables, face acts, helmets and the cooked asset's layout (render/agents people_*; the people shaders)

entries.name: PEOPLE_HAND_ROWS

entries.name: PEOPLE_CLIP_CODE_BASE

entries.name: PEOPLE_ACT_SPAN
entries.doc: the whole of an act, short of the next clip's number (people_renderer.cpp, people_pose.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: FACE_ACT_TALK

entries.name: FACE_ACT_LISTEN
entries.doc: as FACE_ACT_TALK

entries.name: FACE_ACT_PHONE
entries.doc: as FACE_ACT_TALK

entries.name: FACE_ACT_CROUCH
entries.doc: as FACE_ACT_TALK

entries.name: HELMET_COLOURS
entries.doc: the helmets' colours (helmets.cpp, people_helmet.gdshader)

entries.name: WORN_THINGS
entries.doc: the things people wear (worn_things.cpp, people_worn.gdshader worn_bone, worn_at by body, worn_colours)

entries.name: WORN_COLOURS
entries.doc: the colours of one worn thing (worn_things.cpp, people_worn.gdshader worn_colours)

entries.name: PeopleTables
entries.doc: the cooked people (people_asset.cpp reads and checks them): a face row's channels and the rows side by side in face_table (people_face.gdshaderinc), a bone's texels in the palette and a value's (high bytes, then low; people_pose.gdshaderinc), the skeleton's bones (people_skin.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: PeopleSpans

buildings.doc: the buildings: surface kinds and their bits, finishes, panes, bays, sills, cards, condensers and ruins (render/buildings, render/effects ruin_pieces, b40/types.h; the building shaders)

entries.name: SurfaceKind
entries.doc: what a building face is, in its vertex colour's alpha, under SURFACE_KIND_BITS (shell.h; the building shaders). SK_GROUND: a shell face lying on the lot, which stays on it when a level steps back

entries.name: SURFACE_KIND_BITS
entries.doc: the low bits of a vertex colour's alpha byte a SurfaceKind takes; above them a pane's recess (shell.cpp) or the far level's chunk (building_renderer_build.cpp; building_glass_body.gdshaderinc, building_far.gdshader)

entries.name: FAR_OFFICE_BIT
entries.doc: the far level's alpha byte's top bit: its rooms take the office lamps (building_renderer_build.cpp, building_far.gdshader)

entries.name: BuildingRoughness
entries.doc: the roughness of a building face with no finish (building_body.gdshaderinc, building_parts_body.gdshaderinc) and of the far level's (building_far.gdshader); building_light_test holds the engine's own material to them

entries.name: WindowFlags
entries.doc: a far wall's window flags byte (far_mass.cpp writes, building_far.gdshader and building_far_window.gdshaderinc read): a side with no openings, an office's, and from the shift on a PaneDark in its bits

entries.name: PaneDark
entries.doc: how a bay's component picks its dark panes (facade_bay.h pane_dark; building_far_window.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: CardKind
entries.doc: what a card draws, in its UV2.x (shell.h; building_card.gdshader)

entries.name: BayPiece
entries.doc: what a face of the shared bay mesh is, in its UV.x (bay_kit.cpp; building_bay.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: BAY_MESH_MARK
entries.doc: the bay mesh's UV2.y: the vertex stage places it from the instance (bay_kit.cpp; building_body.gdshaderinc reads over it by a half)

entries.name: BayLines
entries.doc: the lines of the bay mesh by name, in its index space, which keeps the real lines' order (bay_kit.cpp lays them; building_bay.gdshaderinc reads each name up to halfway to the next)

entries.name: BayCode
entries.doc: a bay instance's code: the seed byte, the finish + 1, the window flags byte, the depth steps (shell.cpp Shell::bay; building_bay.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: ROOM_SPAN_M
entries.doc: a byte's 1.0 of a room's depth behind a pane, metres (shell.h, building_pane.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: FRAME_SPAN_M
entries.doc: a byte's 1.0 of a frame's thickness, metres (shell.h, building_pane.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: PANE_RECESS_STEP_M
entries.doc: a step of a pane's recess in its colour's alpha above the kind (shell.cpp, building_glass_body.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: BAY_DEPTH_STEP_M
entries.doc: a step of a bay's depth (shell.cpp, building_bay.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: SILL_PAST_M
entries.doc: how much longer a sill is than its opening, both sides together (facade_parts.cpp; building_bay.gdshaderinc takes half each side)

entries.name: SILL_T_M
entries.doc: a sill's thickness (facade_parts.cpp, building_bay.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: SILL_OUT_M
entries.doc: how far a sill stands out of the wall (facade_parts.cpp, building_bay.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: REVEAL_SHADE
entries.doc: the shade of an opening's sides (facade_bay.cpp, building_pane.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: SILL_SHADE
entries.doc: the shade of a sill, of the trim (facade_bay.cpp, building_pane.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: HEAD_SHADE
entries.doc: the shade of an opening's head, of its sides' (facade_bay.cpp; building_pane.gdshaderinc multiplies it by REVEAL_SHADE)

entries.name: BRISE_FINS
entries.doc: the fins of a brise-soleil card (part_models.cpp; building_card.gdshader's pitch is one over this)

entries.name: BAY_PROP_FRONT_MARK
entries.doc: the vertex colour alpha of the condenser case's front, which building_props.gdshader draws (bay_props.cpp; every other part 1)

entries.name: RUIN_PIECES_A_ROW
entries.doc: pieces a row of a ruin's matrix texture (ruin_pieces.cpp, building_body.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: Finish
entries.doc: a building finish, in the cooked texture array's layer order (project/assets/surfaces/building-finishes.*.png; b40/types.h; the building shaders' finish_m, finish_normal_k, finish_metal by layer, and the finishes they leave unweathered)

effects.doc: the blast's effects: debris, puffs and marks on the ground (render/effects; debris.gdshader, puffs.gdshader, marks.gdshader)

entries.name: DebrisMarks
entries.doc: a debris piece's INSTANCE_CUSTOM.a: plain, charred, a building's (dusty) (debris.cpp; debris.gdshader reads each over the one below by a half)

entries.name: PuffKind

entries.name: MarkKind

trees.doc: the trees: what a vertex is, the leaf atlas and the far cards' tint (render/trees; vegetation.gdshaderinc, vegetation_cards.gdshader)

streets.doc: the streets: road materials and codes, lane tones, the wear field and the street props (render/roads, render/wear, render/props; road_body.gdshaderinc, road_wear.gdshaderinc, wear.gdshaderinc, props.gdshader)

entries.name: WEAR_LAYER_CELLS
entries.doc: the cells a side of a wear layer (wear_field.h; wear.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: WEAR_LAYERS_AXIS
entries.doc: the wear layers a side of its texture (wear_field.h; wear.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: ROAD_TONE_SLOTS

entries.name: RoadMat
entries.doc: a road vertex's material, in its colour's alpha times ROAD_MAT_SCALE (road_look.h; road_body.gdshaderinc)

entries.doc: a road vertex's codes (road_look.h): the material's scale in the alpha; UV2.x of a vertex no lamp pool lights and of a junction plate, lit evenly (road_body.gdshaderinc reads past half of each); the distances to a surface's edges and a lane's width over these (road_wear.gdshaderinc)

entries.name: PropTag
